Findings triage: **resolved the co-applied `pm:queue` + `finding` dual state → `pm:queue`** (kept `domain:devx`). The two labels are exclusive states (dispatchable vs held observation); this card is a scoped checklist-strengthening task with a named file (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`), a concrete clause shape mirroring PR #7554's ten route-level pins, and an explicit hand-off into the `checklist-author` flow — queue-class, nothing held about it.

- **Premise**: #7522/PR #7554 landed (the redaction the positive clause will assert); the mirrored test file `settings-routes.test.ts` exists on `origin/main`.
- **Dup check**: #7530 (approvals-area checklist corrections) is the same *class* in a different area file — no overlap in items; not merged into one sweep card here because the two areas' corrections were filed separately with different provenance. The lane may sweep-package them at claim time.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**ACCEPT (both cards)** — PR #7636, continuation complete (all gate jobs green: ESLint, TypeScript Type Check, Dogfood gates, Test Core).

Review record: changed files are exactly the extended surface (2 files, +120/−23 — `areas/platform-core.json` + `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts`). #7573: all ten PR #7554 pins have named homes in the new clauses (masked-as-mask, presence-preserving null, cascadeChain coverage, metadata survival with the 409, both echoed-mask shapes, real-write redacted response, non-encrypted verbatim control, in-process unmasked guard) plus three new negatives — the negative-only shape is gone. #7569: the harness fix is the #7472/#7409 settled spelling (predicate looped against a budget-derived deadline, single `SURFACE_BUDGET_MS` source, last-sample retention so collapsed-panel and no-SVG fail as different assertions), and the checklist item now tells the runner what the suite does; the interim knownGaps entry was correctly self-removed once the harness half closed it. Verification accepted: targeted `tsc --noEmit` on the spec (honestly noting `e2e/` sits outside the package tsconfig — worth a future card if it recurs), `playwright test --list` parses, and the local smoke failure was properly **reverse-verified as environmental** (unmodified spec fails identically) — the CI evidence above is the authoritative reading and it is green. `Fixes` on both cards is now correct — the cards complete.

Landing: flipping ready + arming auto-merge (queue path).
